versions.changelog:
Initial release of xianyu-auto-seller.

- Generates optimized product listings for digital goods (eBooks, templates, PPTs, courses) on Xianyu (闲鱼)
- Creates auto-reply scripts tailored for virtual goods sales
- Offers listing optimization strategies for China’s largest second-hand marketplace
- Includes best-selling digital product categories, title and description templates, and platform rule guidance
- Provides batch listing generation workflow and revenue projections
